newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends flat, stalled at previous low.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends flat, stalled at previous low.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee ended little changed against the dollar on Monday, with the local unit supported at the previous closing low of 56.90, dealers said.
They said the rupee was bound in a tight range.

"Rupee movement was between 56.83 and 56.90," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer. While speculators sold the dollar whenever it reached the top, trade-related buying came in on the downward movement, he said.
"The rupee opened at 56.86 and remained inactive in early trading as dealers were uncomefortable with the near-record low level versus the dollar," said a local bank dealer.
The Central Bank pushed down the rupee by 2.25 local cents, fixing buying and selling rates at 55.9177 and 57.0473 respectively, and worsening uneasiness in the market, dealers said.
The overnight call money rate closed at 15.5 percent after opening at 18.75 percent in the absence of big borrowers, dealers said.
